search_queries: attention without consciousness OR inattentional blindness OR unconscious attention neuroscience [PubMed]
attentional blink temporal consciousness awareness neural [PubMed]

sources.title: Attention and consciousness: two distinct brain processes
sources.reason_included: 奠基性论文，首次系统主张注意与意识的行为学双重解离

sources.title: Growing evidence for separate neural mechanisms for attention and consciousness
sources.reason_included: 2021年最全面综述，涵盖fMRI/EEG/单细胞证据；第一作者是Tsuchiya，领域权威

sources.title: Separate neural definitions of visual consciousness and visual attention; a case for phenomenal awareness
sources.reason_included: Lamme RPT框架的核心论文，定义了现象觉知(phenomenal awareness)vs通达觉知(access awareness)的神经区分

sources.title: Visual Functions Generating Conscious Seeing
sources.reason_included: Lamme 2020年综述，梳理了4阶段视觉模型，图底分离在注意缺席时的神经证据

sources.title: Different Signal Enhancement Pathways of Attention and Consciousness Underlie Perception in Humans
sources.reason_included: 提供机制层面双重解离证据：对比增益(意识)vs响应增益(注意)，并有两级归一化计算模型

sources.title: Gorillas in our midst: sustained inattentional blindness for dynamic events
sources.reason_included: 不注意失察的经典实验，建立有注意无意识的行为证据基础

sources.title: Single-Neuron Correlates of Awareness during Attentional Blinks
sources.reason_included: 提供人类MTL单神经元层面的注意瞬盲证据：概念神经元的减弱/延迟响应与意识缺失相关

sources.title: Revealing robust neural correlates of conscious and unconscious visual processing: Activation likelihood estimation meta-analyses
sources.reason_included: 2023年元分析，54项fMRI研究，系统区分有意识vs无意识视觉处理的脑区激活模式

sources.title: The unconscious guidance of attention
sources.reason_included: 综述无意识注意引导，提供无意识状态下注意运作的机制证据（盲视、掩蔽线索等）

sources.title: Dissociation between temporal attention and consciousness: unconscious temporal cue induces temporal expectation effect
sources.reason_included: 2024年新发现：不可见时间线索仍可产生时间预期效应，直接证明时间注意与意识可分离
